name: Structured Runtime Logging Migration
description: Move repeating runtime noise out of the terminal and into structured per-service JSONL files while preserving startup guidance, failures, interactive scripts, and desktop diagnostics in the terminal.

userStories.title: Centralize runtime log config and profile resolution
userStories.description: As a developer, I want runtime log config and profile resolution centralized so every long-lived runtime derives the same log root and filtering behavior without ad hoc env reads.
acceptanceCriteria: Resolve `LOG_DIR`, `LOG_LEVEL`, and `LOG_STDERR_LEVEL` through `src/server/utils/env.ts`, `src/server/utils/getAppServerRuntimeConfig.ts`, or one shared helper instead of raw call-site env reads.
Add explicit `FORSKA_RUNTIME_PROFILE` propagation for launcher-driven `primary` and `secondary` runs and default unresolved runs to `local`.
Default runtime log roots to `runtimeWritablePath` plus `logs/runtime/<profile>/` so repo and desktop runs land in the correct writable root.

userStories.title: Bootstrap sink-owning runtimes before imports
userStories.description: As a developer, I want sink-owning entrypoints to bootstrap before imports so service naming, sink installation, and runtime identity are fixed before shared modules read process state.
acceptanceCriteria: Make `src/server/index.ts` and `src/appServer.ts` thin bootstrap wrappers or delegate immediately to dedicated bootstrap entrypoints before importing runtime modules that read identity or routing state.

Route every sink-owning launcher through the bootstrap-first path, including package scripts, `scripts/runWithRuntimeProfile.ts`, split-stack launchers, desktop startup, cluster dev helpers, and spawn-based test helpers.
Service selection is fixed at bootstrap: `app-server`, `api-server`, `worker-server`, `dev-single-server`, and `single-server` only for combined `SERVER_ROLE=auto` runs.

userStories.title: Share one runtime process identity
userStories.description: As an operator, I want every server-side log line and writer heartbeat to describe the same process identity so shared daily files stay attributable and runtime metadata never disagrees.
acceptanceCriteria: Add one shared helper that captures `processStartedAt`, `hostname`, `pid`, `listenPort`, `service`, and `runtimeProfile` once per process and emits `instanceId`.

`instanceId` uses `<service>:<hostname>:<listenPort>:<pid>:<processStartedAt>`, app-server records omit `serverRole`, and API, worker, `dev-single`, and direct `single-server` records include `serverRole`.
`src/server/utils/writerConnections.ts` and heartbeat or proxy metadata read the shared identity helper instead of minting a separate `startedAt` value at import time.

userStories.title: Implement the core JSONL runtime sink
userStories.description: As a developer, I want one shared structured sink so long-lived runtimes can write newline-delimited JSON records to stable per-service daily files without inventing a second logging stack.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a shared structured logger that writes one newline-terminated JSON event per write to `logs/runtime/<profile>/<service>-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl`.
Each server-side record carries timestamp, severity, runtime identity, message, event, and structured attrs needed for later ingestion.
The sink installs only in long-lived runtimes and remains process-based rather than module-path-based.

userStories.title: Add append-mode selection, rollover, pruning, and flush
userStories.description: As an operator, I want runtime log files to rotate, prune, and flush safely so the logger remains durable without corrupting JSONL or blocking controlled shutdowns.
acceptanceCriteria: Decide shared-file versus per-instance-file mode once at bootstrap from a tested platform allowlist.

Rotate on UTC date boundaries without restart, prune managed runtime files older than 7 UTC days at bootstrap and rollover, and use instance-suffixed fallback filenames when shared append mode is disabled.
Expose one bounded `flushRuntimeLogs` path and call it from controlled exits in sink-owning runtimes while keeping fatal and duplicate-process exits best-effort and time-bounded.

userStories.title: Extend rateLimitedLogger with explicit sink routing
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the existing rate-limited logging path to route events explicitly so noisy call sites can migrate without losing rate limiting, safe serialization, or terminal fallbacks.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend `src/server/utils/rateLimitedLogger.ts` or a thin runtime logging adapter so touched call sites can choose `file-only`, `both`, `terminal-only`, or `remove-or-dev-only`.
Preserve rate limiting and suppressed-count behavior while reusing the existing safe console serialization path from `installSafeConsoleLogging`.
When a shared-module `file-only` call site runs without the runtime file sink installed, preserve the current terminal behavior instead of silently dropping the event.

userStories.title: Keep startup guidance and failures terminal-visible
userStories.description: As an operator, I want startup guidance and failures to remain obvious in the terminal even after routine noise moves to JSONL files.
acceptanceCriteria: Startup, shutdown, port binding, role summary, and operator guidance events write to both terminal and JSONL even when they are `INFO`.
Unexpected failures, caught exceptions, startup failures, and recovery failures always reach terminal stderr and may also be duplicated to JSONL.
Logging an error does not count as handling it, and existing throws and error-result propagation remain intact after the migration.

userStories.title: Keep interactive scripts terminal-only and isolate spawned tests
userStories.description: As a developer, I want interactive scripts and spawned tests to keep their current console behavior so runtime file logging never turns on accidentally in the wrong process.
acceptanceCriteria: Interactive CLI and JSON-contract scripts such as `startServerStack`, `devServerWatch`, repair scripts, and `dbQuerySnapshot` do not install the runtime file sink.
Importing shared server modules from those scripts does not silently start JSONL file logging.
Spawned tests and one-off harnesses that use sink-owning entrypoints default `LOG_DIR` to temp locations unless they explicitly validate shared profile log behavior.

userStories.title: Migrate judgment queue and raw-fallback progress logs
userStories.description: As an operator, I want recurring queue and raw-fallback chatter moved into structured log files so the terminal stays focused on operator-visible issues.
acceptanceCriteria: Migrate routine progress in `src/server/cron/judgmentsJobs/judgmentsJobsAddToQueue.ts`, `src/server/cron/judgmentsJobs/judgmentsJobsCronGetPrompts.ts`, and `src/services/olap/duckdbOlap.ts` to structured events.
Routine queue and raw-fallback summaries are `file-only` and include structured context such as `component`, `event`, `jobId`, `projectId`, and relevant attrs.
Warnings and errors in these paths remain `both`.

userStories.title: Migrate LLM worker progress logs
userStories.description: As an operator, I want recurring LLM dispatch chatter recorded as structured events so worker noise leaves the terminal without hiding retries and failures.
acceptanceCriteria: Migrate recurring progress in `src/server/cron/judgmentsJobs/judgmentsJobsSendToLLM.ts` and `src/server/cron/judgmentsJobs/judgmentsJobsSendToLLM/processPromptWithLLM.ts` to structured events.
Routine batch, skip, retry, and capacity summaries are `file-only` with structured attrs such as claimed prompts, fulfilled counts, and requeues.
Warnings, errors, and failed processing paths remain `both` and preserve existing failure behavior.

userStories.title: Migrate full-text pipeline progress and timings
userStories.description: As an operator, I want full-text fetch and conversion progress recorded as structured events so hot-path noise leaves the terminal while timings remain queryable.
acceptanceCriteria: Migrate recurring progress in `src/server/cron/fullTextJobs.ts`, `src/server/cron/fullTextConversionJobs.ts`, `src/server/utils/ensureFullText.ts`, and `src/server/utils/convertPdfToText.ts` to structured events.
Replace `console.time` and `console.timeEnd` in these hot paths with explicit `durationMs` fields.
Routine progress becomes `file-only` and warnings or errors remain `both`.

userStories.title: Migrate request, export, and add-articles summaries
userStories.description: As an operator, I want repeating request and export summaries moved into JSONL files so read-heavy flows stop overwhelming the terminal.
acceptanceCriteria: Migrate request-start, request-summary, export progress, streamed-count, and applied-filter summaries in `src/server/routes/ProjectExportRoutes.ts`, `src/server/routes/projectsRoutes/projectsRoutesGetArticlesReviews.ts`, `src/server/routes/projectsRoutes/projectsRoutesGetArticlesReviewsCount.ts`, `src/server/routes/projectsRoutes/projectsRoutesGetArticlesReviewsFilters.ts`, and `src/server/routes/ProjectsAddArticlesRoutes.ts` to structured events.
Routine summaries are `file-only` with explicit request context such as project id, counts, filter summaries, and export attrs.
Warnings and errors in these routes remain `both`.

userStories.title: Migrate background heartbeat and config logs
userStories.description: As an operator, I want steady-state heartbeat and loop-config chatter moved to structured files so long-running workers stay quiet unless they need attention.
acceptanceCriteria: Migrate steady-state heartbeat and config logs in `src/server/utils/projectMartRefreshWorkerHeartbeat.ts` and `src/server/utils/projectMartLargeRebuildHeartbeat.ts` to structured events.
Routine loop-start and config lines are `file-only` with structured attrs for loop configuration and counters.
Warnings and errors in these paths remain `both`.

userStories.title: Integrate desktop runtime logging
userStories.description: As an operator, I want the desktop-backed backend to follow the same structured logging model so routine backend noise moves into JSONL while launcher diagnostics stay easy to inspect.
acceptanceCriteria: Desktop-backed backend writes runtime JSONL under the desktop writable root using `service=dev-single-server`.
`backend.log` continues mirroring stdout and stderr as launcher capture for startup and fatal diagnostics instead of becoming the durable telemetry store.
Apply the same runtime JSONL retention and flush behavior under the desktop data root without forwarding browser or renderer console chatter into backend JSONL.

userStories.title: Remove or dev-gate browser and inspection logs
userStories.description: As a developer, I want browser debug dumps and temporary inspection logs removed from normal runs so they do not pollute either the terminal or the structured server log stream.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove or dev-gate the listed browser debug dumps and success chatter in `src/app/routes/+projects/+$id/+humanAssessment.tsx`, `src/app/routes/+admin/+failed_requests/+$id/+index.tsx`, `src/app/utils/client-env.ts`, `src/components/main/ProjectsGrid.tsx`, `src/app/routes/+projects/+$id/+reviews-llm/+$articleId/+index.tsx`, and `src/app/routes/+projects/+$id/+reviews-llm/+$articleId/+fulltext.tsx`.
Remove or dev-gate the temporary inspection logs in `src/server/routes/HumanAssessmentRoutes/humanAssessmentRoutesPostInit.ts`.
Browser debug logs and temporary inspection logs are not forwarded into the server JSONL pipeline.

userStories.title: Add regression tests for logger plumbing and service selection
userStories.description: As a developer, I want focused regression coverage for the logger plumbing so append safety, service classification, identity capture, and sink routing stay correct as more call sites migrate.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or update tests for JSONL writing, concurrent append safety, shared-file allowlist selection, rate limiting, path selection, runtime-profile propagation, desktop path resolution, env parsing, and 7-day retention pruning.

Cover canonical `api-server`, `worker-server`, `dev-single-server`, and `single-server` selection, bootstrap-before-import identity capture, shared identity between runtime logging and `writerConnections`, and bounded flush-before-exit behavior.
Cover test-isolation defaults and per-instance-file fallback when shared append mode is disabled.

userStories.title: Verify live runtime behavior end to end
userStories.description: As an operator, I want a real runtime verification pass so I know routine progress is file-only, failures are duplicated correctly, profile directories resolve correctly, and concurrent processes remain attributable.
acceptanceCriteria: Run `bun run dev:server`, exercise a reviews flow and an export flow, and confirm routine progress logs are `file-only` while `logs/runtime/primary/*.jsonl` receives structured entries.
Trigger at least one failing request or background-job error path and confirm the failure is `both`: visible in terminal stderr and present in the matching JSONL file.

Verify runtime-profile launchers, direct `single-server` runs, direct `SERVER_ROLE=api` and `SERVER_ROLE=worker` or `SERVER_ROLE=writer` runs, desktop backend logging, and 7-day pruning behavior, and confirm either shared-file attribution or per-instance fallback based on the selected append mode.
